result.title: ART: Bridging the Embodiment Gap in 3D Human-to-Robot Affordance Transfer
result.comment: 15 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://derek0907.github.io/ART/
result.summary: 3D affordance acts as a critical link between perception and action, providing priors for robotic manipulation. While existing approaches predominantly leverage human priors as direct references, they often overlook that affordance is not an object-intrinsic property but is inherently coupled with the agent's embodiment. Due to the structural and morphological disparities between human hands and robot end-effectors, directly applying human priors causes severe incompatibility for robotic execution. Motivated by this, we introduce a novel task setting, 3D Human-to-Robot Affordance Transfer, which addresses the affordance misalignment arising from distinct embodiment structures. To support this task, we construct the Human-Robot Paired Affordance Dataset (HPAD), the first large-scale 3D affordance benchmark in which every object is annotated with both human-prior and simulation-validated robot labels. HPAD covers 2,137 objects across 80 categories and 13 atomic action primitives, yielding over 27,000 object-action pairs. On top of HPAD, we propose the 3D Affordance tRansfer neTwork (ART). ART first filters geometric false positives in the human prior via a reliability gating stream, then reconstructs the prior into a robot-actionable distribution through hierarchical reconstruction and a graph-diffusion refinement that resolves the topological mismatch between human and robot affordances. Experiments on HPAD demonstrate the reliability of the proposed task and the superiority of ART. We further validate ART on a 6-DoF arm with a parallel-jaw gripper in a 2,400-execution benchmark across 12 objects and 4 action categories; ART attains the best success rate (86.5% over its 480 trials), confirming the practicality of the transfer paradigm. Project page: https://derek0907.github.io/ART/

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 3D 人到手 affordance 迁移任务及配对的 HPAD 基准，并设计 ART 网络：先用可靠性门控过滤人类先验中的几何假阳性，再经层次重建与图扩散细化，得到机器人可执行的 affordance 分布。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「可靠性门控筛除假阳性 + 分布细化」的思路可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与状态更新环节，但论文关注机器人可操作 affordance 而非 VLM 内部推理，联系较间接，需进一步确认。
